notes: Stabilizes Maps/Waze HUD guidance during notification changes and reduces background work on the car system while keeping responsive live gauge readings.
changes: DriveCanvas checks for a replacement route before clearing HUD guidance. The Live Vehicle Data page gains a Copy battery signal diagnostic button.
